mapper.select: /* AppAdminApprovalMapper.countPendingCorrOt */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = R.USER_CD WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.sql:
AP.REQ_ID AS reqId , AP.APPROVAL_STEP AS approvalStep , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.USER_CD AS requesterUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', R.USER_CD, null) AS requesterUserNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', R.SITE_CD, R.NODE_CD) AS nodeNm , R.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , R.LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType , U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , LT.LEAVE_NO AS leaveNo , LT.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', U.USE_UNIT_TYPE, 'SYS025') AS unitNm , R.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , U.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes , R.START_TIME AS startTime , R.END_TIME AS endTime , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS reqDate , CASE WHEN R.USER_CD = #{approverUserCd} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS selfYn
, R.LEAVE_GROUP_ID AS leaveGroupId
, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BU.LEAVE_DAYS), 0) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE BU JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT BG ON BG.CMPNY_CD = BU.CMPNY_CD AND BG.GRANT_ID = BU.GRANT_ID AND BG.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BG.GRANT_REASON LIKE '[가불] %' WHERE BU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND BU.REQ_ID = R.REQ_ID AND BU.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND BU.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS borrowDays

FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL AP JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = AP.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = AP.REQ_ID
LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U ON U.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (R.REQ_TYPE = '05' AND U.REQ_ID = R.REQ_ID AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.LEAVE_ID = ( SELECT MIN(X.LEAVE_ID) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = R.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' )) OR (R.REQ_TYPE = '06' AND U.LEAVE_ID = R.TARGET_ID) ) LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = U.LEAVE_CD
mapper.select: /* AppAdminApprovalMapper.countPendingLeave */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL AP JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = AP.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = AP.REQ_ID WHERE 1 = 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectPendingLeaveGrouped */ SELECT
JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(R.LEAVE_GROUP_ID, R.REQ_ID) AS GK , MAX(R.INSERT_DATE) AS GK_DT FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL AP JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = AP.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = AP.REQ_ID WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY COALESCE(R.LEAVE_GROUP_ID, R.REQ_ID) ORDER BY GK_DT DESC, GK DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) G ON G.GK = COALESCE(R.LEAVE_GROUP_ID, R.REQ_ID) WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY G.GK_DT DESC, G.GK DESC, R.WORK_YMD ASC, R.REQ_ID ASC

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.countPendingLeaveGroups */ SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(R.LEAVE_GROUP_ID, R.REQ_ID)) FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL AP JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = AP.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = AP.REQ_ID WHERE 1 = 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectReqMeta */ SELECT R.REQ_ID AS reqId , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.USER_CD AS userCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', R.USER_CD, null) AS requesterUserNm , R.SITE_CD AS siteCd , R.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , U.NODE_CD AS requesterNodeCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', R.SITE_CD, COALESCE(R.NODE_CD, U.NODE_CD)) AS nodeNm , R.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , R.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , R.TARGET_ID AS targetId , R.START_DATE AS startDate , R.START_TIME AS startTime , R.END_DATE AS endDate , R.END_TIME AS endTime , R.LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType , R.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , R.SCH_CD AS schCd , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS reqDate FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = R.USER_CD WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectAttdSnapshot */ SELECT M.CHECK_IN_DATE AS checkInDate , M.CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime , M.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS checkOutDate , M.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT M WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M.ATTD_ID = #{attdId} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectLeaveBody */ SELECT U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , LT.LEAVE_NO AS leaveNo , LT.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(U.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', U.USE_UNIT_TYPE, 'SYS025') AS unitNm
, CASE WHEN U.REQ_ID = #{reqId} THEN ( SELECT SUM(X.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = U.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ELSE U.LEAVE_DAYS END AS leaveDays , U.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes , U.START_DATE AS startDate , U.START_TIME AS startTime , U.END_DATE AS endDate , U.END_TIME AS endTime
, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BU.LEAVE_DAYS), 0) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE BU JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT BG ON BG.CMPNY_CD = BU.CMPNY_CD AND BG.GRANT_ID = BU.GRANT_ID AND BG.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BG.GRANT_REASON LIKE '[가불] %' WHERE BU.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND BU.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND BU.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND BU.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS borrowDays
, U.EVIDENCE_FILE_ID AS evidenceFileId FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = U.LEAVE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (U.REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED') OR (#{targetId} IS NOT NULL AND U.LEAVE_ID = #{targetId}) )
ORDER BY U.LEAVE_ID LIMIT 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectSchedBody */ SELECT CS.SCH_CD AS curSchCd , CS.SCH_NO AS curSchNo , CSE.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS curFstStrTime , CSE.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS curFstEndTime , CSE.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS curSecStrTime , CSE.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS curSecEndTime , TS.SCH_CD AS reqSchCd , TS.SCH_NO AS reqSchNo , TSE.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS reqFstStrTime , TSE.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS reqFstEndTime , TSE.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS reqSecStrTime , TSE.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS reqSecEndTime
, CSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS curPreFixedOtStrTime , CSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS curPreFixedOtEndTime , CSE.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS curFixedOtStrTime , CSE.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS curFixedOtEndTime , TSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS reqPreFixedOtStrTime , TSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS reqPreFixedOtEndTime , TSE.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS reqFixedOtStrTime , TSE.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS reqFixedOtEndTime FROM TB_SCH_MGMT TS LEFT JOIN ( ) TSE ON TSE.CMPNY_CD = TS.CMPNY_CD AND TSE.SITE_CD = TS.SITE_CD AND TSE.SCH_CD = TS.SCH_CD
AND TSE.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= #{workYmd} THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = TS.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = TS.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = TS.SCH_CD ) LEFT JOIN TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP ON WP.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND WP.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT CS ON CS.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND CS.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND CS.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD LEFT JOIN ( ) CSE ON CSE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND CSE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND CSE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD
AND CSE.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= WP.WORK_YMD THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD ) WHERE TS.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND TS.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND TS.SCH_CD = #{reqSchCd} LIMIT 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectDefaultSchChangeBody */ SELECT CS.SCH_CD AS curSchCd , CS.SCH_NO AS curSchNo , CSE.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS curFstStrTime , CSE.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS curFstEndTime , CSE.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS curSecStrTime , CSE.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS curSecEndTime , TS.SCH_CD AS reqSchCd , TS.SCH_NO AS reqSchNo , TSE.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS reqFstStrTime , TSE.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS reqFstEndTime , TSE.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS reqSecStrTime , TSE.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS reqSecEndTime
, CSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS curPreFixedOtStrTime , CSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS curPreFixedOtEndTime , CSE.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS curFixedOtStrTime , CSE.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS curFixedOtEndTime , TSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS reqPreFixedOtStrTime , TSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS reqPreFixedOtEndTime , TSE.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS reqFixedOtStrTime , TSE.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS reqFixedOtEndTime FROM TB_SCH_MGMT TS LEFT JOIN ( ) TSE ON TSE.CMPNY_CD = TS.CMPNY_CD AND TSE.SITE_CD = TS.SITE_CD AND TSE.SCH_CD = TS.SCH_CD AND TSE.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= #{asOfYmd} THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = TS.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = TS.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = TS.SCH_CD ) LEFT JOIN TB_USER U2 ON U2.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U2.USER_CD = #{userCd} LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT CS ON CS.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND CS.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND CS.SCH_CD = U2.DEFAULT_SCH_CD LEFT JOIN ( ) CSE ON CSE.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND CSE.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND CSE.SCH_CD = U2.DEFAULT_SCH_CD AND CSE.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= #{asOfYmd} THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SE.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND SE.SCH_CD = U2.DEFAULT_SCH_CD ) WHERE TS.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND TS.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND TS.SCH_CD = #{reqSchCd} LIMIT 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectDayScheduleBody */ SELECT CS.SCH_CD AS schCd , CS.SCH_NO AS schNo , CSE.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstStrTime , CSE.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstEndTime , CSE.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secStrTime , CSE.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secEndTime , CSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS preFixedOtStrTime , CSE.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS preFixedOtEndTime , CSE.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS fixedOtStrTime , CSE.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS fixedOtEndTime FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT CS ON CS.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND CS.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND CS.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD LEFT JOIN ( ) CSE ON CSE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND CSE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND CSE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AND CSE.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= WP.WORK_YMD THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD ) WHERE WP.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND WP.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} LIMIT 1

/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.selectHistoryCorrOt */ SELECT R.REQ_ID AS reqId , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.USER_CD AS userCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', R.USER_CD, null) AS requesterUserNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'NODE', R.SITE_CD, COALESCE(R.NODE_CD, U.NODE_CD)) AS nodeNm , R.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS reqDate , DATE_FORMAT(R.PROCESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS processDate , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.PROCESS_USER_CD AS processUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(R.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', R.PROCESS_USER_CD, null) AS processUserNm , R.PROCESS_COMMENT AS rejectReason FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = R.USER_CD WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY R.PROCESS_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
/* AppAdminApprovalMapper.countHistoryCorrOt */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = R.USER_CD WHERE 1 = 1
